answer: Randomized Admission Ridge. Each epoch, a verifiable random function over the epoch seed assigns identities to shards along a hidden ridge of slots; only assigned agents may submit, and assignment is revealed after commit. An attacker must populate every atlas slot in advance, since shard placement is unknown until the seed opens. A violet flag marks slots whose pre-committed proofs fail, voiding them. Cost: one full pre-committed proof per slot per epoch, unamortizable.
